title: Nexus: Core Loop
summary: Approach anomalies, read the signal, prepare the response, and leave a route back.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Locate signal activity, scan the source, identify the required counter, interact only when prepared, and record the result in Wiki or Terminal.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each signal, decide whether it asks for gear, information, power, distance, or restraint. Do not treat every anomaly like a loot chest.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Pull back when the site starts answering questions you did not ask. Mark the threshold and return with a specific plan.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
